title: DOW-UAP-D080, Narrative Statement 2, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a memorandum for record containing first-hand narratives of three UAP incidents reported by a federal law enforcement agent to AARO in 2023.

incidents.summary: Witness observed a bright orb-like light that expelled smaller red lights which maneuvered in formation, followed by the red lights hovering over the southern horizon for several hours.
incidents.quote: The bright orb-like light had a smaller red orb-like light within it.

incidents.summary: Witness observed two vehicles flashing lights and a triangular formation of red lights, followed by a pursuit of an object that morphed into a box-like shape and glided over rugged terrain.
incidents.quote: The object floated with an impossible, eerie stillness.

incidents.summary: Witness observed a single bright orb-like light on a rural highway that mimicked a vehicle, transitioned between orb and taillight, and eventually disappeared near a semi-truck.
incidents.quote: The object appeared highly reactive to our interaction with it.
